title: Hack Back Group Chat
coreMove: Separate chat's coordination value from its ambient presence pressure by naming channels, urgency, and expected response speed.
sourcePressure: The chapter distinguishes group chat by its speed and visible-presence pressure, focusing on norms and urgency rules rather than blaming the app.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would mute everything or blame chatty people without defining what the room is for.

hook: Hack Back Group Chat as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: community disaster-volunteer chat before a flood watch
exampleSpecs.audience: volunteer coordinator with one channel full of jokes and road reports
exampleSpecs.stakes: urgent sandbag requests can disappear in chatter
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she splits flood operations from social check-ins and pins the urgent radio call sign
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A flood-watch map is taped above a pinned radio call sign.

exampleSpecs.domain: restaurant opening team coordinating final inspections
exampleSpecs.audience: manager whose chat mixes jokes, vendors, and fire-marshal tasks
exampleSpecs.stakes: opening day slips if inspection asks scatter
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he labels one thread 'inspection blockers only' and moves menu chatter elsewhere
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A fire-marshal checklist sits beside a taped thread label.

exampleSpecs.domain: distributed translation team handling subtitle fixes
exampleSpecs.audience: lead translator pulled by every ping during timing review
exampleSpecs.stakes: a subtitle release gets inconsistent if fixes lack channel rules
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she creates timing-critical and wording-later channels before opening the review reel
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A subtitle timeline glows beneath a two-channel rule card.

exampleSpecs.domain: minor-league equipment staff during away-game packing
exampleSpecs.audience: clubhouse manager whose chat mixes requests with travel jokes
exampleSpecs.stakes: missing gear costs the team warmup time
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he pins a gear-only list and tells players reactions are not confirmations
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A cleat inventory tag lies beside a pinned gear-only list.

exampleSpecs.domain: nonprofit legal hotline volunteers sharing shift updates
exampleSpecs.audience: shift lead seeing every message as immediate
exampleSpecs.stakes: clients wait while volunteers react to side commentary
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, side comments trigger everyone; after, only case-number pings require same-hour response
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A hotline case card rests under a same-hour response note.

exampleSpecs.domain: film festival projection team handling screening changes
exampleSpecs.audience: projectionist juggling booth prep and chat alerts
exampleSpecs.stakes: wrong version files can screen if urgency is not explicit
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she marks file-change pings with one code and moves applause photos to a later channel
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A DCP drive case sits beside a file-change code card.
